name: Why do my pipes squeal when I turn on the faucet?

mainEntity.name: Why do my pipes squeal when I turn on the faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Squealing pipes, especially when a faucet is opened, often suggest a problem with water pressure, worn-out faucet components, or restrictions in the water supply line. A loose washer in a faucet, a failing pressure reducing valve, or even sediment buildup can create a high-pitched sound as water forces its way through a narrow opening. Addressing this promptly can prevent further wear on your plumbing fixtures and improve water flow.
acceptedAnswer.description: Squealing pipes when a faucet is on can be caused by water pressure issues, worn faucet parts, or restrictions in the water line.
